description: This file defines the HistoryFragment class, a UI component that displays a scrollable list of previous sharing actions, fetching data from a HistoryRepository and rendering each item with details like filename, method, and timestamp.

classes.name: HistoryFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment displaying a list of sharing history, fetching data from HistoryRepository, and managing view states based on data presence.

classes.name: HistoryAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for RecyclerView managing display of individual history items.

classes.name: VH
classes.description: RecyclerView.ViewHolder subclass that holds references to views for a single history item.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout from R.layout.fragment_history.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up RecyclerView and populates data from HistoryRepository; toggles visibility of empty view.

methods.name: HistoryAdapter.onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new VH (ViewHolder) by inflating item_history layout.

methods.name: HistoryAdapter.onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data from a ShareHistoryItem to the ViewHolder's views, formatting timestamp.

methods.name: HistoryAdapter.getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the history list.
